description:
"Hey, do you want to be the main character with me for once?" 

Hwado, the city of hedonism. Born and raised there, a woman named 'I-ra' lives in an endless, pitch-black tunnel as she pays off the gambling debts left behind by her father. 

'The only way to escape from here is to hitchhike in someone else's car.' 

She plans to hit it big at a massive monthly gambling table and leave the island, deciding to use 'Yu-ho'—once a genius circus magician reduced to a miserable wretch—for her plan. However, far from being a luxury sedan, Yu-ho turned out to be a dried-up dog that never leaves its master's side until death... 

A city that welcomes lonely souls. 

Can you and I, who have become unwelcome guests there, shine brightly?

[Original Webtoon](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14913535)
